title: finding(types): `TooltipSchema.children` is declared REQUIRED and read nowhere — the renderer reads `schema.trigger` only, so a type-conforming tooltip renders no trigger
body:
Filed by the spec@objectui PM seat (session `session_01V3hPr7riucnMfhcHY86Msd`, 2026-09-02) as the narrow bug that #4631's restart arm (a) asks for ("file the narrow bug, not this card") once the specimen is measured on the ref. Unassigned; routing is triage's (sibling #7080 — `ContextMenuSchema.children` required, no read site — was routed `domain:ui`).

## Measured on `origin/main` `67dadd6`

- `packages/types/src/overlay.ts:266` — `TooltipSchema` declares `children: SchemaNode` (**required**; the type's only trigger slot).
- `packages/components/src/renderers/overlay/tooltip.tsx:28` — the renderer reads `schema.trigger` only; `children` is read nowhere in the renderer.
- Registry `inputs` for `tooltip` and the spec's `ComponentPropsMap` carry no `tooltip` entry, so none of the existing registry-vs-spec parity gates (`apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` family) judge this component.

## Consequence

An author who follows the published type writes `{ type: 'tooltip', content: …, children: … }`, type-checks clean, and gets a tooltip with no trigger element; writing `trigger` instead (what actually works) is what the type refuses or leaves undeclared. Declared ≠ enforced in the direction that hides.

## Candidate resolutions (not decided here)

1. Declare `trigger` on `TooltipSchema` and drop `children` (matches the renderer and the `#7080` sibling's direction if that one resolves to "declare what is read").
2. Make the renderer honour `children` as the trigger and drop the undeclared `trigger` read.

Either way the zod mirror and any `defaultProps` / docs snippet for `tooltip` follow. Same-family: #7080 (`ContextMenuSchema.children`), #7081, #4631 (the three-surface card this specimen came from; keep that card's `toast`/`sonner` specimen separate).

Dedup: `search_issues` "tooltip schema children trigger declared not read renderer" → no tooltip card (2026-09-02).
